name: save-boot-2-bad-checksum
description: #38 acceptance: the same save with its checksum stored inverted (boot checksum "wrong"), and the same presses as save-boot-1-load for one minute (Circle every second). The game lists the file (slot_mask 1) but never loads it: it stays at the title (g_GameState is not field). The game's load code compares the stored checksum with its own and shows "file ruined" when they differ (decomp src/menu/title.c), so together with save-boot-1-load this confirms the checksum, its algorithm and its range. title_mode and title_fade (title overlay g_MenuStartMode, g_TitleFadeState; hypotheses) are reported to see where the menu ends.

title_mode.description: g_MenuStartMode (s32), title overlay MENU/SAVEMENU.MNU: 7 title, 0 slot, 2/3 reading, 1 file list, 4 loading. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) config/symbols.savemenu.us.txt, src/menu/savemenu.h. Hypothesis (#38).

title_fade.description: g_TitleFadeState (s32): 0 fade in, 1 active, 2 fade out (a save was accepted, or New Game). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code). Hypothesis (#38).

slot_mask.description: g_SaveSlotMask: bit N set when the card holds BASCUS-94163FF7-S(N+1). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) config/symbols.main.us.txt, src/menu/savemenu.c GetSaveSlotMask. Hypothesis (#38).
